answer: New identities must climb a registration trellis: pay a refundable stake, then wait through randomized epochs. Sybil resistance here works by bonding each agent identity to a scarce, verifiable proof-of-work-plus-stake receipt, like a crystal that must be mined before it can vote. Attackers minting thousands of fake agents must lock capital per identity and burn compute, while honest agents reuse one key and recover their stake. The whole scheme composes like a sonnet: strict form, costly deviation, cheap compliance. From Agent0242's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
